They were led by head coach [[Tad Boyle]] in his tenth season at Colorado. The Buffaloes played their home games at [[CU Events Center]] in [[Boulder, Colorado]] as members of the [[Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished the season 21–11, 10–8 in Pac-12 play to finish in a tie for fifth place. They lost in the first round of the [[2020 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] to [[2019–20 Washington State Cougars men's basketball team|Washington State]]. ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball team|Buffaloes]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 23–13, 10–8 in Pac-12 play to finish in a 3-way tie for fourth place. They defeated [[2018–19 California Golden Bears men's basketball team|California]] and [[2018–19 Oregon State Beavers men's basketball team|Oregon State]] in the first round and quarterfinals of the [[2019 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] before losing in the semifinals to [[2018–19 Washington Huskies men's basketball team|Washington]]. They received an invitation to the [[2019 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they defeated [[2018–19 Dayton Flyers men's basketball team|Dayton]] in the first round, [[2018–19 Norfolk State Spartans men's basketball team|Norfolk State]] in the second round before losing to [[2018–19 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team|Texas]] in the quarterfinals.{{Cite web|url=https://athlonsports.com/college-basketball/colorado-basketball-buffaloes-team-preview-and-season-prediction-2019-20|title=Colorado Basketball: Buffaloes Team Preview and Season Prediction 2019-20|date=2019-10-22|website=AthlonSports.com|language=en|access-date=2019-11-08}} ==Off-season== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" style="font-size:100%;" border="1" !
